One step before you start

Lemmata needs TeX Live to build PDFs

Lemmata uses the TeX installation on your computer. It looked in your PATH and the usual install folders and found nothing. Install it with the command below, then click Check again.

latexmkrequired
pdflatexrequired
biberoptional
xelatexoptional
synctexoptional

Install it

sudo pacman -S --needed texlive-basic texlive-latex texlive-latexrecommended texlive-latexextra texlive-fontsrecommended texlive-bibtexextra texlive-binextra texlive-mathscience biber

Open a terminal shows the command and waits for you to press Enter. Lemmata never installs TeX Live by itself.

Or use Tectonic: nothing to install

A small LaTeX engine (about 11 MB). It fetches each package the first time a document needs it, so the first build needs an internet connection. biblatex with biber isn't supported; use BibTeX.

Installed somewhere else? Choose the TeX bin folder
